info.text:
Unpaid overtime? Federal law can make your boss pay it twice.

Under the Fair Labor Standards Act, unpaid minimum wage or overtime can come with an equal amount in liquidated damages if you sue, plus attorney's fees if you win.
You can only recover the last 2 years, or 3 if the violation was willful.
Example: 5 unpaid overtime hours a week at $20/hr is $7,800 a year, or $15,600 doubled.
The Labor Department recovered $259 million in back wages alone for 176,957 workers in fiscal 2025.

Sources: Fair Labor Standards Act (29 U.S.C. 216, 255, 260), US Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division, EPI.
News and education, not financial advice.
